Add second living character ONLY when the target object is that character, or essential to show a human body part; no bystanders. Friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermark, including books, money and clothing. Single scene, not collage.
